rationale: Build toolchain pins only. generate.py now writes experimental/pulp-rs/rust-toolchain.toml from tools/toolchain/manifest.toml, check_env.py also checks the pinned Rust components and targets, the new tools/toolchain/host_sync.py installs the pinned tools on a host, and CI installs the pinned Rust before building pulp-rs. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
